chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān and al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “What suffices of utterance in the rukuʿ and the sujud?” He said, “Three tasbihat in one measured manner, and one complete utterance suffices.”

key_terms.تُجْزِي: is sufficient and fulfills the requirement

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum tasbih that suffices in rukuʿ and sujud?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum sufficient dhikr to be said in rukuʿ and sujud during salat. It indicates that either three tasbihat recited in a measured manner, or one complete formula of tasbih, is sufficient.
